PLPC belongs in the adjacent chokepoint lane as transmission-line hardware rather than transformer/switchgear; thesis survival depends on evidence that grid transmission orders accelerate ahead of construction backlogs.

node: Transformers, switchgear, power quality products, and electrical distribution magnetics
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around power-delivery chokepoints for electrification, AI data centers, renewables and grid modernization. The reference lane is represented by Hubbell as a diversified, higher-attention utility/electrical solutions comp. The underfollowed lane prioritizes narrower US-listed exposure in medium-voltage switchgear, transmission-line hardware, and critical-power systems where order timing, backlog, lead times, and customer qualification may reveal second-order demand before it is visible in hyperscaler or utility capex headlines. No candidate is a recommendation; weak mappings are explicitly marked as hypotheses or speculative exceptions.
